Click a button element and verify success

```csharp title="C#"
using System;
using System.Text.Json;
using Crawlberg;

var ConfigOptions = new JsonSerializerOptions { PropertyNameCaseInsensitive = true };
var engineConfig = JsonSerializer.Deserialize<CrawlConfig>("{\"browser\":{\"mode\":\"always\"}}", ConfigOptions)!;
var engine = CrawlbergConverter.CreateEngine(engineConfig);
var url = "https://example.com";
var result = await CrawlbergConverter.InteractAsync(engine, url, new List<PageAction>() { JsonSerializer.Deserialize<PageAction>("{\"selector\":\"#submit\",\"type\":\"click\"}", ConfigOptions)! });
Console.WriteLine(result.ActionResults[0].Success);
Console.WriteLine(result.ActionResults[0].ActionType);
Console.WriteLine(result.ActionResults[0].ActionIndex);
```
